name: legal-compliance-fanout-completeness-gate
description: Enforces freelunch/parallel-fan-out sourcing completeness: any legal-compliance proposal or record that claims a multi-source or multi-angle survey (a "Sources" heading, or a heading using "scout"/"sweep"/"compared against"/"survey") must list at least two independently-attributed sources or angles, not one source restated. Fires on both docs/issue-<n>/proposals/*legal-compliance*.md and docs/issue-<n>/reports/legal-compliance.md write surfaces.
